assessmentName: AIQ Expert Assessment - Complete Professional Edition
description: Expert-level AI literacy with 160 professional questions and complete sentence options with balanced lengths

assessmentConfiguration.targetAudience: AI strategy leaders, senior data science professionals, executives

instructions: Expert assessment evaluating world-class AI literacy across 8 dimensions. 160 questions, 150 minutes.

itemBank.description: Expert-level strategic assessment of AI capabilities, organizational transformation, and competitive positioning

items.question: Your organization is developing a comprehensive multi-year AI strategy. Which framework best balances the need for near-term value delivery with long-term capability building?
options: Pursue a portfolio approach with parallel quick wins and strategic capability investments.
Focus primarily on quick wins to build momentum and secure stakeholder support for investment.
Invest heavily in foundational infrastructure, accepting slower initial value delivery.
Benchmark leading competitors and systematically match their AI maturity trajectory over time.
items.rationale: Expert-level strategic analysis requires synthesizing multiple competing considerations and understanding context-dependent trade-offs in organizational AI deployment.
items.explanation: This question tests ability to evaluate complex scenarios and select approaches that balance multiple strategic objectives.

items.question: An AI system achieves 92% accuracy on your test dataset. What additional analysis is most critical before proceeding with enterprise-wide deployment?
options: Detailed comparison with human expert baseline performance on identical task samples.
Comprehensive error analysis examining failure patterns, severity, and subgroup disparities.
Confidence calibration analysis ensuring predicted probabilities align with actual accuracy.
Adversarial robustness testing to evaluate performance under intentional attack scenarios.
items.rationale: Expert-level strategic analysis requires synthesizing multiple competing considerations and understanding context-dependent trade-offs in organizational AI deployment.
items.explanation: This question tests ability to evaluate complex scenarios and select approaches that balance multiple strategic objectives.

items.question: Your data science team proposes implementing a novel neural architecture that improves performance by 7% but requires significant engineering effort to productionize. How should you evaluate this proposal?
options: Accept the proposal if the performance improvement translates to meaningful business value.
Analyze the improvement against total cost, maintenance burden, explainability, and flexibility.
Reject the proposal to avoid technical debt unless the improvement exceeds ten percent.
Approve it as a research initiative while maintaining the current production system in parallel.
items.rationale: Expert-level strategic analysis requires synthesizing multiple competing considerations and understanding context-dependent trade-offs in organizational AI deployment.
items.explanation: This question tests ability to evaluate complex scenarios and select approaches that balance multiple strategic objectives.

Conduct proof-of-concept implementations with both approaches, then select based on results.
Evaluate strategic differentiation, speed-to-value, total cost, learning goals, and lock-in risks.
